decisive_items: completed a course of prostate-directed radiation therapy
large deep-cratered solitary ulcer on the anterior rectal wall with firm margins, friability, and exudate
Biopsies of the lesion were negative for malignancy
response.rationale: Recent prostate-directed radiation therapy with an anterior rectal wall ulcer and negative malignancy strongly favors radiation proctitis; R1 is merely a descriptive finding rather than an etiologic diagnosis.

rejected.why: Overly broad descriptive diagnosis that does not incorporate the key radiation history and anterior rectal ulcer location, which are specific for radiation proctitis.
